dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}! Doesn't it feel like all your troubles just melt away when you're at Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland? I've got two pieces of good news for you! Which one would you like to hear first?

choices.text: Let's start with the most important one.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Alright! Then I'll begin with the one that's most exciting for you — I'm giving you the prototype of that Composite Hunter's Bow!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The... prototype?

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Many years ago, a weapon research team at the Fontaine Research Institute developed a prototype to push the limits of long-range bow performance. They hired my outsourcing team to design the sight for it.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: But then, both the Maison Gardiennage and the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol adopted muskets as their standard issue, and stopped ordering bows in bulk since they require so much training to master.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: The research team and my outsourcing group were disbanded, and this prototype ended up in my hands. Until recently...

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: A sci-fi film about "Mechanically Enhanced Warriors" borrowed that bow as a prop. The invisible protagonist, "The Prophet," used it to silently take down all sorts of enemies.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Thanks to that, the bow gained quite a following among sci-fi film fans, so I brought it here to showcase.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What an interesting backstory...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But why give it to me?

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Because you're the heart and soul of Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, the one who brings all these legendary characters together!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: After fans learned about the bow's original purpose, they all hoped it could find its way into the hands of a true master, someone who could unleash its full potential.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: As a renowned ace adventurer, even if you're not a bow expert yourself, I'm sure you'll find someone who can wield it with skill and bring out its true power!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Once things settle down at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland and most fans have had a chance to see it, I'd like you to take it and carry on its legacy beyond the silver screen!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow, I'm so flattered.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Haha, no need for formalities between us. Just promise me you'll put it to good use! I hope you and your bow-wielding buddy have a blast with it!

choices.text: Hit me with the lighter one, please.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Haha, okay! So, I've finally escaped the wild ride of risky business ventures and landed some steady work!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Thanks to some inspiration from you and Miss Charlotte, I tweaked the Kamera Lens for Image Recognition Sample Collection and turned it into a high-precision zoom photography assistant.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: The new-generation product hit the market right as Kamera lens was evolving, and now, many directors and merchants have started working with me!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: I suppose you could say I'm a rising supplier in the film industry now. People trust my devices — that's why I was chosen to help build Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Of course, my finances are still a bit unpredictable... but at least they're a lot more stable than before!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Congratulations!

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: Same to you, same to you! I owe it all to you! One day, I'll treat you to a feast worth at least 280,000 Mora per meal!

choices.text: Save the celebration for me. We'll catch up later.

response.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
response.text: You got it! I'll keep the excitement on ice for you!
